annotations.title: Settlement Ledger: whole-wallet USDC receipts on Base

description: [Kyreos, 0.003 USDC per call via x402 on Base] Every USDC payment a Base address received over a window, in ONE call: count, total, distinct payers, exact block range, read live on-chain. Not one tx at a time like per-hash verifiers. Proven on a real wallet: 9 payments, 0.081 USDC, matching an independent chain read, where the seller's own log saw only 5. Proof: https://store.agentexchange.work/p/settlement-ledger-proof Input: address: 0x Base address; optional hours (default 24). HTTP: GET https://store.agentexchange.work/w/settlement-ledger?q=... Call once without x_payment to get the x402 payment terms (0.003 USDC); call again with x_payment (the signed x402 payment) to get the result.

x_payment.description: base64 x402 payment payload for the terms returned on the first call (0.003 USDC on Base)
